{"reason": "All shown failures are low-confidence moves (0.44-0.67) or sub-750k exposure; v1 ignores confidence. Added a confidence gate, waived only for extreme |pct|>0.4 to protect recall, and raised exposure to 750000. Fixes rows like pct=0.224 conf=0.44 and pct=0.194 exposure=680k, keeping -0.428-type moves arbitrable.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 750000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (or (high-confidence? edi-change)
           (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.4))))"}
